summary: Pass for bounded opt-in evaluation groups 1/2/4/8 against the supplied working32B baseline diff (dd6f19f47c5bd4f94d76281b00dfad6265327a20). The default layer loop is unchanged. CPU receive completes before local layer graphs; final block hidden state and every live block KV state complete before CPU send. Ragged blocks, intermediate dtype checks, fresh caches and post-evaluation completion events are preserved. Both peers receive the admitted flag and receipts are checked against that admission, not merely peer agreement. No consequential regression or security issue found. This is scheduling/admission approval, not a physical 32B parity or performance result; those runs remain pending with the parent.

tests.details: Audit guards prohibited MLX/MLX-LM imports, network connect/bind/name resolution, SSH and download/install/Git tools. No blocked operations occurred and no MLX runtime modules were imported. Local subprocess cleanup and durable failure receipts passed.

Default per-layer loop AST and phased-forward distributed-call AST match the supplied baseline diff exactly. Added-line scan found no shell injection, unsafe deserialization or dynamic-code execution.

tests.name: Grouped scheduling, KV and truthful completion review
tests.details: Inspected production logic and existing real-model parity, failure-injection, ragged-block and mocked-handoff test source. Block evaluation includes final h plus every current block cache.state; all layer_done events follow successful evaluation. Receive is evaluated on its CPU stream before layers are constructed, and all local block evaluations precede send on the CPU stream. Generation forwards the option through prefill and decode. Numerical MLX/GPU tests were read, not executed in this independent review.
